name: k2_anime-real
prompt: an anime girl drawn with clean lineart and flat cel shading, pink twintails, school uniform cardigan, composited into a real photograph of a busy city street, photorealistic background with bokeh, f/1.8, warm afternoon sunlight matching on both, documentary photo style
note: 动画人物 + 真实照片背景。关键在提示词：先用 clean lineart / flat cel shading 把人物钉成动画，再用 real photograph / photorealistic background / bokeh / f1.8 把背景钉成照片，最后用 sunlight matching on both 让光统一 —— 两边风格不分开描述，模型就会整张拉成一边。LoRA 只做辅助：bold-inked 0.9 打底，kieed 与 kazutake 各 0.3 左右点缀，rim_light 0.4 压逆光边缘，detail_slider 0.3 补细节。换角色和场景只改提示词前两段，后半段（照片 + 光照）不要动。
